t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes always come in the same color combos, so as the x1 is displayed, choose the color that gives more mushrooms which will be between 1 and 9

vb_textbox.text: When choosing gnomes some think that you can estimate which gnome will give more mushrooms by comparing the color pairings (which always stay the same) during the x1 rounds, but personally I think they change and switch up during the 4 larger rounds. My advice is to see which gnome gives the most mushrooms, but know that it can change in the main 4 rounds.
